text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I escort Air Groove to the infirmary after she suffers an injury during training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ugh. The thought of falling behind due to such a small injury is…
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, I should've been more cautious.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I was the one doing the exercise—I'm the one who needs to reflect on what happened.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This makes for a good lesson though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I shall strive to avoid repeating such a careless mistake in the future.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Easier said than done. Every second wasted is a second you'll never get back.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This failure on my part will continue to haunt me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: All I can do is accept the loss and double down on my training once I recover.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Easier said than done. You can't make up for lost time with a run-of-the-mill work ethic.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do you understand the consequences of what you're insinuating?
choice_data_list: We'll both give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then get ready to continue training at a moment's notice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll be back at it as soon as I've recovered from this irksome injury!
